mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side recovery, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 2% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also decline, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS declines
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS declines and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when Industrial Production (INDPRO) is growing but the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a supply-side constraint, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO is growing and UNRATE is rising and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.
